verdict.rationale: skills.sh's CLI does offer update commands and an experimental skills-lock.json restore mechanism that could support versioning/rollback, and skills are plain files committed to a project (implying git-based review is possible), but there is no documented review/diff tooling and a community comment explicitly states that skills.sh-style tools 'don't document any way to do basic package management things like updates, version-pinning, or even uninstalls,' directly contradicting the vendor's own lock-file/version claims. missing for 10: explicit rollback/version-history commands beyond the experimental lock-file restore, a review/diff workflow for skill changes, and resolution of the community's claim that version-pinning isn't actually documented.
